input.note: Researcher-selected opportunity; four supplied source-linked assessment intervals are not probabilities, authenticated evidence, or customer acceptance. Single-candidate native screening is not cross-arm ranking. All token values are unsubmitted format fixtures, independent of CAD budgets; no funded capital is asserted.

opportunities.goal: Construct and independently check a consenting, funded roster-and-care arrangement.
opportunities.successMetric: A fresh synthetic case gains a funded accepted arrangement while staffing, full care, qualifications, consent and finite fallback remain intact; conventional parity and failures stay visible.
opportunities.thesis: Consenting roster changes across employers can concentrate fragmented care demand into a funded qualified opening. A coupled commitment instrument preserves production, individual choices and finite fallback obligations. Existing flexible-care and consortium services are strong prior art; the contribution is a tested bounded construction, not a claim of historical firstness.
opportunities.title: Joint roster commitments that make a care cohort fundable
